requirements.subject: organization
requirements.obligation: exercise care with, identify, verify, protect and safeguard property belonging to customers or external providers that is under the organization's control or provided for use or incorporation into products and services; report to the owner and ensure documented information is available as evidence of what occurred
requirements.object: when such property is lost, damaged, or otherwise found unsuitable for use
requirements.condition: applies throughout custody of the property; reporting/evidence obligation triggers when it is lost, damaged, or found unsuitable for use
